text: Category navigation for Characters, Items, Buildings/world, UI, Data/text and Audio, plus the resource register and issue register.
Searchable resource list and production-status collection for all 180 obligation IDs, including zero results, partial imports, exact resource diagnostics and expandable provenance fields.
One large character media preview with live body, equipment, logical hand, direction, movement and action controls, playback speed, pause and single-step.
Item, structure, map, effect, corpse and crowd media previews with state selectors and inspectable identity summaries.

Reusable list and grid state resources UI-05, UI-06, UI-07, UI-10, UI-13 through UI-17, UI-20 through UI-22 and UI-27, including legacy layouts, conflicting data, equal labels and long identity names.
Reusable UI-01, UI-03, UI-09 through UI-11, UI-17 through UI-19, UI-22, UI-23 and UI-25 forms and controls, including waiting, disabled, invalid, conflicting and failure examples.
UI-02, UI-04, UI-07, UI-08, UI-12, UI-21, UI-24 and UI-26 text, identity and warning resources; TXT-01 and TXT-02 expanded strings, missing-glyph fallbacks and current binding labels.
DT-01 through DT-27 and TXT-01/TXT-02 data and text collection with field, unit, default, range, dependency and reference details, missing definitions and local preferences fixtures.
AU-01 through AU-30 sound and ambience collection with explicit play, stop and loop audition controls, selected recording metadata, event bindings, buses, volume, mute and visible warning examples.
UI layout media preview and state controls for authored 1280x720 and 1920x1080 canvases, 80 to 150 percent UI scale and long replacement text, without implementing future gameplay transactions.
